title: `_add_floating_ip` cyclomatic complexity 17 (67 lines)
detail: `_add_floating_ip` (lines 200–274) has CCN=17 across 67 lines. Each additional branch multiplies test cases needed for full coverage. Fix: extract one or more decision-heavy sub-routines.

title: 11× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 74)
detail: At 11 location(s) (first at line 74), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.

title: Line 56: inconsistent return statements — some paths return a value, some don't
detail: The function at/near line 56 has paths that return a value and paths that fall off the end (implicit `return None`). Callers expecting a return value silently receive `None` on the implicit path. Fix: add explicit `return None` or ensure all paths return a consistent type.

title: too-many-branches (R0912) — function(s) at line 200
detail: A function has more branches than pylint's threshold. High branch count multiplies test cases needed for coverage and makes the function a defect magnet. Fix: extract decision clusters into named helper functions.

title: Builtin `id` shadowed by local variable (W0622)
detail: Local variable(s) at lines 90, 159, 200, 281 shadow the builtin(s) id. If the builtin is needed elsewhere in the same scope, the shadowing causes a confusing `TypeError` or silent misbehavior. Fix: rename the local variable to avoid shadowing.
